description: Audio-grounded SRT subtitles for videos up to five minutes

defaultPrompt: สร้างไฟล์ SRT จากวิดีโอนี้ โดยยึดเสียงจริงและรักษาช่วงเงียบ
interface.longDescription: Generate SRT subtitle files from videos up to five minutes, preserving Thai, English, and mixed-language speech. The workflow uses audio-derived word timings, preserves silence gaps, and checks that subtitles stay within the video duration. Requires a compatible Python execution environment, faster-whisper, and a local speech model. Early Access: review generated subtitles against the original audio before use.
